dimensions.note: 2D or more: first dimension = one row per iteration (iteration count is not knowable ahead of the loop actually running - Loop's exact termination condition is an open design question, see core-spec.md Section 10); remaining dimension(s) = one column per entry of outputVariableMap

each entry collapses the iteration dimension of [id] to a single value (per Repeat, the applied dimension defaults to this Loop's own iterations), unless the underlying subTask output was itself multi-dimensional, in which case that dimensionality carries through per entry

[id].range.note: the current value of range, within the loop

[id].index.note: the current index into range, within the loop
